name: Pentokey Organy (India) Limited
about: Pentokey Organy (India) Limited engages in trading of pharmaceutical products in India. It also trades fertilizers and pesticides products. In addition, the company manufactures, trades, and sells organic chemicals, such as acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and acetaldehyde. Pentokey Organy (India) Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
